query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN delivered_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as completed_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN customer_latitude IS NOT NULL AND customer_longitude IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as orders_with_coords, MIN(createdAt) as earliest_order, MAX(createdAt) as latest_order FROM orders WHERE createdAt >= '2026-05-01' AND createdAt < '2026-06-01';
